notes.title: Demo version | Modified the threshold of unlocking the door
notes.content:
The specifications regarding the threshold of unlocking the door was different between the demo version and the full version.
The differences was a hindrance to create gameplay hints.
And, I decided removing the differences.
The full version is not changed in this time.

[b]Change Details:[/b]
[list]
[*] The threshold value of unlocking the door rose.
[*] The expected value of random numbers presented by enemy characters rose also.
[/list]


The hints page is in an external site.
If you interested in it, Refer Q&A page linked the "View the manual" button in the store page.
